description: How the three-card mind, body and spirit tarot spread works: what each position means, how to lay it out, and how to use it as a gentle regular check-in.
lede: The mind, body and spirit tarot spread is a three-card check-in on your thoughts, your daily energy and your sense of meaning. It is for reflection, not health advice.

layout.alt: A triangle tarot spread of three numbered cards. Card 1 Mind sits at the lower left, card 2 Body at the lower right, and card 3 Spirit at the top centre.
layout.caption: Mind and Body form the base, with Spirit above them. Read the three as a set before reading each one.
